exposure: changes in perioperative N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP)
cohort: 873 children who underwent surgery for congenital heart disease (CHD)
finding: Dynamic increases in postoperative NT-proBNP levels were significantly associated with a higher risk of short-term adverse events in children after CHD surgery.
mod_finding: Age, weight at surgery, mode of delivery, and cardiopulmonary bypass time were associated with the pattern of NT-proBNP change.
